description: Record that a Capability is a step of a Flow (PART_OF_FLOW), with its position in `step_order`. A flow is an ordered sequence of capabilities — a use case, a process, a data path — and `flow_report` walks it in order. A step WITHOUT `step_order` is listed after the ordered ones, and the report says so. Where the flow starts and ends is COMPUTED from the order, so it cannot go stale. A capability may be a step of several flows. A step names the parts it puts together (`puts_together`) and the joins it makes (`closes`) in the same call, all or nothing. Ask for this when you want to record that a capability is one step in a larger sequence. MANY AT ONCE: `draw_edges` with `edges`: [{"tool": "part_of_flow", "arguments": {…}}], same checks, all or nothing.

capability_id.description: The Capability (`cap:…`) that is a step of the flow.

closes.description:
The JOINS this step makes — after it, what each Interface says must
hold there holds — as Interface ids (`ifc:…`): one CLOSES from the step
to each. Every id must name an Interface, or the WHOLE call is refused
naming each one that does not, and nothing is written. Additive, like
`puts_together`.

echo.description: What the reply carries. `receipt` (the default) names the node, echoes each stored value of at most 200 characters, gives longer ones by size, and names the snapshot that keeps anything a revise replaced. `node` returns the whole stored node and every prior value.

flow_id.description: The Flow (`flow:…`, from `add_flow`) the capability is a step of.

puts_together.description:
The PARTS this step puts together — places, joins or assembles —
as Component ids (`cmp:…`): one PUTS_TOGETHER from the step to each.
Every id must name a Component, or the WHOLE call is refused naming
each one that does not, and nothing is written. Additive: a part an
earlier call named and this one leaves out is kept (`delete_edge`
takes one away).

step_order.description:
Position of this capability within the flow. Steps without one are
listed after the ordered ones, and the flow report says so.

name: part_of_flow
title: Add a Step to a Flow
